Selected survey kosukɨ/kosuvu/kosuvi, Irula kusune/kusuna and kotuvu/kodugu match the documented velar/dental/sibilant variants. Extended kosukisi-type responses are excluded pending analysis of their additional material. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5354 gives Tamil vāyil/vāyal/vācal/vāytal doorway, Malayalam vātil, Kannada bāgil/bāgal/bākal, Tulu bādhaḷa and Kota vāl entrance door. Selected southern survey vāsa/vācal/bāsa/vātil/bādal/bāgalu and Kota vāl preserve the documented lateral, dental and sibilant variants and lect contractions. Full doorway-step compounds are kept separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4415 gives Tamil perukku and Malayalam perukkuka sweep with Kannada porake/parake broom. Survey perukku elicited as broom is a lect nominal use of this sweep/broom family; retain the nominal survey meaning rather than silently changing the gloss to a verb. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 gives Tamil cem-/civa- red with past -nt-, Malayalam cem-/covva/cuvappu/cōppu red, and Kannada kempu. These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
